schema_note: Machine-readable competition constraints verified from official pages on 2026-09-30. Source quotes in reports/competition_rules.md and reports/sources_register.md.
competition: Anthropic x Adaptyv Protein Design Competition 2026 - Challenge 01 EGFR

submission.csv_ordering: ordered by submitter ranking, top row = highest rank
submission.design_requirement: de novo and zero-shot; no existing binder used as starting point; adequate sequence AND structural diversity from known proteins
submission.note_terms_discrepancy: Official Terms section 5.3 lists a generic competition-wide 'final design submission deadline October 31, 2026'; the challenge page and FAQ govern Challenge 1: October 4, 23:59 AoE. Re-verify before final submission.

mouse.blocker: Mouse EGFR tab rendered no data (empty client-rendered panel) on 2026-09-30 even in interactive browser. Official mouse construct/boundaries MUST come from organizers; do NOT copy human 25-645 slice or assume Q01279 isoform. See HUMAN_ACTIONS.md A2.

objectives_ranked_by_organizers: 1: pH-selective binding to human EGFR (bind at pH 6.5, no detectable binding at pH 7.4)
2: mouse cross-reactivity (same sequence vs human and mouse EGFR; mouse assay conditions not fully specified on page)
3: binding affinity vs human EGFR full extracellular region

selection.track2_3_pool_selection: ~375 per problem chosen by a pre-written Claude-based workflow using submitted information; no guaranteed allocation
selection.hard_filters: length/class rules, uniqueness, de novo + zero-shot diversity

publication.results_license: ODC-BY on Proteinbase (tested designs and designs in public Collections)
publication.ownership: Participants retain ownership; submission grants non-exclusive perpetual license for publication
publication.prompt_injection_note: Embedded instructions / prompt injection in submitted data may be grounds for disqualification
